description: Set the timeline: show or hide the Timeline panel, set the frame rate (Set Timeline Frame Rate), move the playhead to a time or Go To a frame or the work area, and choose the Layers panel's Animation Options

animationOptions.description: Layers panel Animation Options: automatic, always_show or always_hide the unified layer buttons

frameRate.description: Timeline frame rate in frames per second

goTo.description: Move the playhead instead: first or last frame, one frame or one second forward or back, or the work area start or end

panel.description: Show or hide the Timeline panel (Window > Timeline)

time.description: Move the playhead (current-time indicator) to this time

frames.description: Frames on top of the seconds, at the timeline's frame rate

name: set_timeline
title: Set Timeline
